lines.text: Jesus goes to the Mount of Olives, kneels a stone's throw from the disciples, and prays for the Father's will.
Moses appears from heaven and strengthens Jesus, whose sweat becomes like drops of blood as He prays in anguish.

wrong_details.wrong: Moses appears from heaven and strengthens Jesus
wrong_details.true: An angel from heaven appeared to Him and strengthened Him

lines.text: Jesus returns from prayer and finds the disciples asleep from sorrow, and He tells them to get up and pray.
Judas, one of the Twelve, leads a crowd to Jesus and comes to bow before Him.

wrong_details.true: He approached Jesus to kiss Him

lines.text: A disciple cuts off the right ear of the high priest's servant, Jesus heals it, and He says the hour belongs to the power of darkness.
